properties.name: The redo-list requirement is marked built in part: propagate_from returns a redo list by kind, not yet by trade
properties.rationale: Option (b) of dec:idea-reflow2-becomes-the-web-of-rules-for-a-buildings-ifc-model (accepted by @ajs 2026-10-24). The list is built from links that already exist: a kept output's inputs, DOCUMENTS, GOVERNED_BY from a part to a decision, CONSTRAINS, DEPENDS_ON between parts, and REALIZES from a model to a part. A drawing names its model through its own inputs. Grouping by trade needs a trade on each part, which no field holds today. Naming the dependencies an agent drew unchecked needs a reading of who drew an edge. Both are @ajs's to shape, so coverage is partial. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
